newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's short-term PHIBOR rates higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's short-term PHIBOR rates higher.

text.p: The short-term Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were higher on Wednesday and the rest were mixed after the Central Bank decided to maintain its 20 percent overnight borrowing rate, traders said.
The Central Bank had adjusted its rate since Friday to fend off speculation arising from the problems of the Thai baht.
Short-term rates rose because the Central Bank may extend the 20 percent rate for a week, traders said.
"The soonest the Central Bank will lower its rate is Monday. He'll hold the 20 percent in the meantime to punish speculators," one dealer said.
